name: Aorta SVS/STS 10 Zones
description: SVS/STS reporting standards for thoracic aortic aneurysm (Fillinger et al., J Vasc Surg 2010)

landmarks.label: STJ
landmarks.name: Sinotubular Junction
landmarks.description: Junction of the aortic root and ascending aorta, just above the sinuses of Valsalva.

landmarks.label: BCA
landmarks.name: Brachiocephalic Artery
landmarks.description: Origin of the brachiocephalic (innominate) artery from the aortic arch.

landmarks.label: LCCA
landmarks.name: Left Common Carotid
landmarks.description: Origin of the left common carotid artery from the aortic arch.

landmarks.label: LSA
landmarks.name: Left Subclavian Artery
landmarks.description: Origin of the left subclavian artery from the aortic arch.

landmarks.label: PDescA
landmarks.name: Proximal Descending
landmarks.description: Approximately 2 cm distal to the left subclavian artery origin.

landmarks.label: MDescA
landmarks.name: Mid Descending
landmarks.description: Mid-level of the descending thoracic aorta (approximately at the pulmonary artery bifurcation).

landmarks.label: CT
landmarks.name: Celiac Trunk
landmarks.description: Origin of the celiac trunk at the diaphragmatic level.

landmarks.label: SMA
landmarks.name: Superior Mesenteric Artery
landmarks.description: Origin of the superior mesenteric artery.

landmarks.label: RA
landmarks.name: Renal Arteries
landmarks.description: Level of the most inferior (lowest) renal artery origin.

landmarks.label: ABif
landmarks.name: Aortic Bifurcation
landmarks.description: Bifurcation of the aorta into the common iliac arteries.
